title: Trace feature
description: The general spine (proposal B4). Every feature in every domain has this shape, which is what lets rendering, the time slider, and cross-layer analysis stay domain-agnostic. Adding a domain adds a `domain` value and a hue — never a field.

id.description: Stable within a domain and a pipeline run. Used to key selection state.

domain.description: Which subject this feature belongs to. Drives the extent hue.

subtype.description: Optional finer class within the domain — pond, reservoir, river, coast.

valid_from.description: Year the state begins. An integer year, not a date: every v1 source is annual, and the time slider filters on this numerically — `["<=", ["get", "valid_from"], year]`. A date string would break that expression and imply precision the 30 m annual sources do not have.

valid_to.description: Year the state ends. null means the state is current — it has not ended as of the source's last observed year.

change_type.description: The universal change signal. Rendering colour is a pure function of (domain, change_type): extent uses the domain hue, loss uses the cross-domain red/amber.

metric.description: Quantified magnitude. At least one measure must be present — a feature with no number cannot answer "how much", which is the product's whole claim.

source.description: Dataset and version, e.g. "UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2025_v1_13". Carried per feature so a mixed tileset stays attributable.

method.description: How this feature was derived — "JRC GSW YearlyHistory", or a segmentation model id. Makes the extraction reproducible and auditable.

confidence.description: 0–1. Surfaced in the UI rather than smoothed over (A5).

allOf.description: A state that has ended cannot end before it began.

then.$comment: Ordering (valid_to >= valid_from) is enforced in code; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values.
